units.source_text: 源氏公子见她如此痴心相爱，便觉难于抛舍。

en.t: Seeing how deeply and devotedly she loved him, Prince Genji felt it would be hard to abandon her.

units.source_text: 但天明后人目众多，有所不便，只得硬着心肠出发了。

en.t: But after daybreak there would be many eyes watching, making things inconvenient, so he had no choice but to harden his heart and set out.
